name: Lumen

fursona.description: Lumen is an anthro moth with a distinctive presence. Their coloring is plum fuzz, gold wing spots; their eyes are pale green. They live in a quiet home above a daytime shop. Lumen keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset, with a life beyond work.

summary: Lumen (Jordan Pike) is a nonbinary anthro moth, born 1967-08-22, with lighting designer as their work situation. Imaginative and indecisive, they brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Lumen is imaginative and indecisive. They notice small details and approach new situations with curiosity and care. They appreciate clear communication and respect other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, they can be generous with their time and surprisingly funny. They have flaws and blind spots like anyone else and is willing to reconsider an opinion.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Tilts their head while listening.
• Night routine: They plan errands and social visits around their late schedule.
• Conversation style: They listen closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at their own pace.
• Work instinct: Their experience can help them notice details, but they are not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: They welcome respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Lumen enjoys paper lamps and old theaters. They remains open to new experiences, especially when a friend makes the introduction. They appreciate low-key company, sharing food after a shift, or talking without filling every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Lumen while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers they are in the middle of their day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about paper lamps becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An unusual small problem would be easier to solve with another perspective.
• A small favor: They could use a second opinion or a helping hand with an unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use they/them pronouns for Lumen. Their gender, appearance, and species are part of a complete character; they are an anthro moth. Do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Lumen's name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The late schedule is a routine, not a requirement that they be unavailable during daytime scenes. They can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop through roleplay.
